name: Grand Reveal (photo-real)
tagline: A product unveiled on scroll: your video played frame by frame.
best_for: Cars, luxury goods, launches, hotels — anything worth unveiling

media.ask: This design plays real footage as you scroll. Do you have a video of the reveal (or its frames)? Attach it with 📎. No video? Lyra can use 2–5 photos of the same shot, make AI pictures on your ChatGPT plan, or start with placeholders.
